desc: High-energy pub with Indian & foreign beers, plus casual bites & lots of TVs showing football.
addr: Doffpub , 654, 2nd, 10th A Main Rd, above BIBA, Stage 1, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India

rev.t:
Doff Pub is a proper old-school sports pub.

Dropped by for the Chelsea vs Liverpool screening and stayed back for the United …

It is a sports bar with very good varieties of veg and non veg along with variant of both toits beer and common bottled beers.
Their coorg pork was very good. …

This place is a legendary hang-out spot! For nearly four years, it's been my go-to for fantastic food and stellar service. The sports bar vibe is on point with screens galore, and the foosball is a total goal!
